title: Bible Stories Samson defeats the Philistines
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 6 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child retells Judges 15:14-17: bound and handed over at Lehi, Samson is freed when the Spirit of the Lord comes on him, the ropes fall like burnt flax, he strikes a thousand Philistines with a donkey's jawbone; outlines how Christians depend on God in challenges.

floor.prerequisite: Knows Samson killed a lion by God's power.
floor.question: Where did Samson's strength come from in Judges 14?

representations: ropes drawn falling like burnt thread
steps: Samson is bound and handed over.
The Spirit comes on him; the ropes fall off.
contexts: a family facing a long illness

board.do: Write Judges 15:14 and draw ropes falling.

board.say: Who made the ropes fall off?

board.do: Wait for the child to say the Spirit of the Lord.
List ways Christians depend on God today.

misconceptions.ask: What gave Samson power against the Philistines (Judges 15:14)?
misconceptions.repair: Read Judges 15:14: "the Spirit of the Lord came powerfully upon him". Compare with Judges 14:6 in Grade 4.

misconceptions.ask: What did Samson use to strike the Philistines (Judges 15:15)?
misconceptions.repair: Read 15:15 and show a picture of a jawbone: God used something weak and ordinary.

misconceptions.ask: How many men did Samson kill with it (Judges 15:15)?
misconceptions.repair: Read 15:16 where Samson himself says "a thousand men".

listen_for: He cut them with a knife
misconceptions.ask: How did the ropes on Samson's arms come off (Judges 15:14)?
misconceptions.repair: Read 15:14 and act burnt thread falling apart. God freed him.

checks.question: What did Samson use to strike the Philistines?
